```{r}
#| label: Hola

data.frame(x = 1.0, y = 1.0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  
  # Se dibujan dos cromosomas:
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.01, xend = 1.01, y = 3.0, yend = 4.0, colour = 'black', alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 4.8, linetype = 'solid', lineend = 'round') +
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.02, xend = 1.02, y = 3.0, yend = 4.0, colour = 'black', alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 4.8, linetype = 'solid', lineend = 'round') +

  # Se dibuja el locus donde estará el SNP:
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.009, xmax = 1.011, ymin = 3.88, ymax = 3.9, colour = 'red', fill = 'red', alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = 'longdash') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.019, xmax = 1.021, ymin = 3.88, ymax = 3.9, colour = 'red', fill = 'red', alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = 'longdash') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.005, y = 3.89, label = 'Locus', size = 3.2, colour = 'black') +
  
  # Se dibuja uno de los cromosomas más grande:
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.05, xend = 1.10, y = 2.5, yend = 2.5, colour = 'black', alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 28.8, linetype = 'solid', lineend = 'round') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.105, xmax = 1.107, ymin = 2.5, ymax = 2.5, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 8.4) +
  annotate(geom = 'segment', x = 1.112, xend = 1.162, y = 2.5, yend = 2.5, colour = 'black', alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 28.8, linetype = 'solid', lineend = 'round') +

  # :
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.05, xmax = 1.053, ymin = 2.40, ymax = 2.60, colour = 'red', fill = 'red', alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.055, xmax = 1.058, ymin = 2.40, ymax = 2.60, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.01) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.060, xmax = 1.063, ymin = 2.40, ymax = 2.60, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.01) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.065, xmax = 1.068, ymin = 2.40, ymax = 2.60, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.01) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.070, xmax = 1.073, ymin = 2.40, ymax = 2.60, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.01) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.075, xmax = 1.078, ymin = 2.40, ymax = 2.60, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.01) +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.080, xmax = 1.083, ymin = 2.40, ymax = 2.60, colour = 'black', fill = 'black', alpha = 0.01) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.092, y = 2.50, label = 'ADN', size = 7.2, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.03, xmax = 1.033, ymin = 2.60, ymax = 2.80, colour = 'red', fill = 'red', alpha = 0.2) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0315, y = 2.75, label = 'A', size = 4.2, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0315, y = 2.65, label = 'T', size = 4.2, colour = 'black') +
  geom_curve(x = 1.05, xend = 1.035, y = 2.55, yend = 2.70, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.8, color = 'black', curvature = 0.0, linetype = 'solid') +
  annotate(geom = 'rect', xmin = 1.03, xmax = 1.033, ymin = 2.20, ymax = 2.40, colour = 'red', fill = 'red', alpha = 0.01) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0315, y = 2.35, label = 'C', size = 4.2, colour = 'black') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.0315, y = 2.25, label = 'G', size = 4.2, colour = 'black') +
  geom_curve(x = 1.05, xend = 1.035, y = 2.45, yend = 2.30, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.8, color = 'black', curvature = 0.0, linetype = 'solid') +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 1.054, y = 2.14, label = 'SNP', size = 3.2, colour = 'black') +
  geom_curve(x = 1.052, xend = 1.0515, y = 2.16, yend = 2.315, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.4, color = 'black', curvature = -0.1, linetype = 'solid') +
  geom_curve(x = 1.0215, xend = 1.0515, y = 3.89, yend = 2.745, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, 'inch')), size = 0.8, color = 'black', curvature = -0.1, linetype = 'longdash') +
  



  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1.0, 1.18)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.0, 4.0)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank())
```
